prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: NPC075 happy horizontal-thinking eye atlas. Use only the single supplied local reference grid. It shows the selected happy open-eye source on the top row and the selected happy half-lid source on the bottom row.

Create exactly one 2×2 atlas of equal complete 64×35 native upper-face crops, canvas ratio 64:35. No labels, gutters, dividers, borders, padding, zooms, extra rows, or panels. Exact row-major order: LEFT OPEN / RIGHT OPEN / LEFT HALF / RIGHT HALF.

Preserve the selected NPC075 happy expression, including its newly corrected warm, relaxed cheerful brow arc, soft smile-eye creases, exact eye spacing, source aperture, hair fringe, framing, and low-contrast warm-brown pixel palette. Keep the original compact dark olive-brown/amber iris and dark pupil clusters. Only shift gaze horizontally, about one native pixel per eye. In LEFT poses, both iris/pupil clusters shift toward the same canvas-left side; in RIGHT poses, both shift toward the same canvas-right side. Keep both eyes aligned and convergent; neither iris may stay centered while its partner moves. Do not change iris size, color, shape, or lid anatomy.

Keep sclera shaded dark olive-brown like the reference and mostly lost in shadow. Do not create cream-white horizontal bands, broad pale patches, bright white flashes, or enlarged eyeball whites. Use only tiny muted warm glints. The lower row must retain the source half-lid aperture, with upper lids covering most of each iris; do not reopen the eyes or shrink the irises to fit. Keep hair and all pixels outside the eye feature unchanged. Preserve native pixel clusters, no smooth/vector look, blur, gradients, text, watermark, or new objects.
